stalls.summaryZh: 只賣蔥油餅和加蛋兩樣，現做外酥內Q，可自己加醬；趁熱吃最好，冷了偏油，賣完就收。
stalls.summaryEn: Sells only two items, plain or with egg; made to order, crisp outside and chewy inside, with self-serve sauces. Best hot, as it gets oily when cold; closes when sold out.

stalls.zh: 阿成蚵仔煎（功夫蚵仔煎）
stalls.summaryZh: 邊緣煎得焦香酥脆、醬汁足，蚵仔算大顆新鮮；可搭酸菜鴨湯或豬血湯。
stalls.summaryEn: Crisp, slightly charred edges and plenty of sauce, with fairly large, fresh oysters; pair it with duck soup or pork blood soup.

stalls.summaryZh: 東門夜市的老牌臭豆腐，酥炸版本是招牌、常被列入必吃；但也有部落客覺得普通、份量偏少，評價兩極。
stalls.summaryEn: A long-standing stinky tofu stall under the overpass; the crispy version is its signature and often listed as a must-try, though one blogger found it ordinary and small. Opinions are split.

stalls.summaryZh: 先炸後烤再刷醬，外皮焦脆、肉不乾柴，是在地人推薦的雞排。
stalls.summaryEn: Fried, then charcoal-grilled and brushed with sauce, so the skin is crisp and the meat stays juicy; a local favorite.

stalls.summaryZh: 烤串入味、肉質嫩，常大排長龍，採取號碼牌叫號取餐。
stalls.summaryEn: Well-seasoned, tender skewers with a long line; you take a number and wait to be called.

sources.title: 食尚玩家｜宜蘭夜市推薦

stalls.zh: 善美（三色布丁豆花・燒仙草・八寶冰）
stalls.summaryZh: 東門夜市知名甜品店，夏天賣布丁豆花與八寶冰、冬天賣燒仙草，價格親民、甜度適中，假日要排隊。
stalls.summaryEn: A well-known dessert shop: pudding douhua and eight-treasure ice in summer, hot grass jelly in winter. Affordable, moderately sweet, with weekend queues.

stalls.summaryZh: 營業超過30年的銅板小吃，只賣三樣、價格極低；有人提醒偶爾炸過頭，建議沾醬吃。
stalls.summaryEn: A 30-plus-year stall selling three items at pocket-change prices; one blogger found it a bit overfried and suggests the sauce.

stalls.summaryZh: 醬汁濃厚的烤玉米，在地人愛買，部落客等了約20分鐘。
stalls.summaryEn: Grilled corn with a thick glaze, popular with locals; one blogger waited about 20 minutes.

sources.title: 食尚玩家｜宜蘭夜市推薦

foodsEn: Tofu pudding with mung bean, tapioca, peanut
stalls.where: 聖後街第47攤（天橋下臭豆腐旁）
stalls.summaryZh: 銅板價豆花，配料有綠豆、粉圓、花生，是吃完鹹食後的平價甜點。
stalls.summaryEn: Pocket-change douhua with mung bean, tapioca and peanuts; a cheap dessert after savory snacks.

sources.title: 食尚玩家｜宜蘭夜市推薦

stalls.summaryZh: 古早味手搖冰品，比手搖杯便宜，檸檬口味最被推薦。
stalls.summaryEn: An old-school shaken ice drink, cheaper than bubble tea shops; lemon is the top pick.
